problems.title: A power with base bounded below one
problems.question: Find the limit of[(2n+3)/(3n+2)]^(n+1).
problems.idea: Use the identity or geometric relation below, including the domain restrictions.
formulas: The base tends to2/3<1.
steps: For sufficiently large n,the base is positive and at most some fixed q<1,such as0.8.
The expression is then bounded by q^(n+1),which tends to0.

problems.title: A standard exponential limit
problems.question: Find the limit of[(3n−2)/(3n+2)]^(n+199).
problems.idea: Use the identity or geometric relation below, including the domain restrictions.
formulas: The base is1−4/(3n+2); ln(1+u)/u→1 as u→0.
steps: The logarithm of the expression tends to lim(n+199)(−4/(3n+2))=−4/3.

problems.title: Leading coefficients in a rational limit
problems.question: Find lim[(3n−n³+4n⁵+2)/(3n+2n⁵+1)]³.
problems.idea: Use the identity or geometric relation below, including the domain restrictions.
formulas: Divide numerator and denominator inside by n⁵.

problems.title: Ratio of two radical differences
problems.question: Find lim[√(n²+2n)−√(n²−2n)]/[√(n²+n)−√(n²−n)].
problems.idea: Use the identity or geometric relation below, including the domain restrictions.
formulas: Rationalize each difference.

problems.title: An interior singularity of a radical function
problems.question: Find discontinuities of f(x)=√(x−3)/(x²−6x+5).
problems.idea: Use the identity or geometric relation below, including the domain restrictions.
formulas: Domain:x≥3,x≠5; denominator=(x−1)(x−5).
steps: The value1 is outside the real domain’s closure relevant to this function. At3 the function is right-continuous.
At5,the numerator is nonzero and the denominator vanishes,giving an infinite discontinuity.
problems.note: The source uses the usual school convention of including the interior excluded singularity among discontinuity points.

problems.title: A removable limit at nine
problems.question: Find lim as x→9 of(x√x−27)/(x²−81).
problems.idea: Use the identity or geometric relation below, including the domain restrictions.
formulas: Set t=√x→3. Then numerator=t³−27,denominator=t⁴−81.
steps: Factor to obtain(t²+3t+9)/[(t+3)(t²+9)] after canceling t−3.

problems.title: Differentiate a square root of a quotient
problems.question: For f(x)=√[(x−1)/(2x−1)],find f′(0).
problems.idea: Use the identity or geometric relation below, including the domain restrictions.

problems.title: Differentiable at every domain point
problems.question: Which listed function is differentiable everywhere on its domain:|x|,|cosx|,|x³−1|,|x²−1|,|x|−1,or tanx?
problems.idea: Use the identity or geometric relation below, including the domain restrictions.
formulas: Absolute values have corners at simple zeros of their inner functions.
steps: The first five have such corners.
tanx is differentiable wherever it is defined,with derivative1/cos²x.

problems.title: Product rule at a logarithm’s zero
problems.question: f(x)=xcosxlnx. Find f′(1).
problems.idea: Use the identity or geometric relation below, including the domain restrictions.
formulas: Product rule gives f′=(cosx−xsinx)lnx+cosx.

problems.title: A periodic division recurrence
problems.question: a₁=6,a₂=3,aₙ₊₁=aₙ/aₙ₋₁. Find a₁₉₈a₂₀₁₉.
problems.idea: Use the identity or geometric relation below, including the domain restrictions.
formulas: The first six terms are6,3,1/2,1/6,1/3,2; the next two are6,3,so the recurrence repeats with period6.

problems.title: Derivative of a radical-logarithm combination
problems.question: For a=199,find derivative of√(x²+a²)−a ln[(a+√(x²+a²))/x].
problems.idea: Use the identity or geometric relation below, including the domain restrictions.
formulas: Let s=√(x²+a²),s′=x/s; the real logarithm here requires x>0.
steps: The first two terms combine to x/(a+s)=(s−a)/x. Adding a/x gives s/x.

problems.title: Simplify before differentiating an inverse tangent
problems.question: On[0,π),differentiate arctan√[(1−cosx)/(1+cosx)].
problems.idea: Use the identity or geometric relation below, including the domain restrictions.
formulas: The square root is|tan(x/2)|=tan(x/2) because0≤x/2<π/2.
steps: The principal arctangent therefore gives f(x)=x/2.
Differentiate on the interior; the right derivative at0 is the same.

problems.title: A derivative at a logarithmic argument
problems.question: f(x)=(eˣ−1)/(eˣ+1). Find f′(ln3).
problems.idea: Use the identity or geometric relation below, including the domain restrictions.
formulas: Quotient rule:f′=2eˣ/(eˣ+1)².

problems.title: A cubic trigonometric limit
problems.question: Find lim as x→π/2 of cos³x/(x−π/2)³.
problems.idea: Use the identity or geometric relation below, including the domain restrictions.
formulas: Let h=x−π/2; cosx=−sinh.

problems.title: Continuity at a replaced point
problems.question: f(x)=a sin2x/sinx near x=π,and f(π)=−2. Find a for continuity there.
problems.idea: Use the identity or geometric relation below, including the domain restrictions.
formulas: For nearby defined x,sin2x/sinx=2cosx.

problems.title: Three lateral-area portions of a cone
problems.question: Parallel planes divide cone lateral area in ratio4:21:24 from the apex. In what ratio do they divide a generator?
problems.idea: Use the identity or geometric relation below, including the domain restrictions.
formulas: Similar cone lateral areas scale as squared generator lengths.
steps: Cumulative areas are4,25,49,so cumulative generator units are2,5,7.

problems.title: An insphere-to-base-radius relation
problems.question: A cone’s insphere radius is its base radius divided by√3. Find cosine of its generator’s angle to the base.
problems.idea: Use the identity or geometric relation below, including the domain restrictions.
formulas: For base radius r,height h,slant l,ρ=rh/(r+l). Let c=r/l=cosθ.

problems.title: Cone surface outside a hemisphere
problems.question: A cone has height twice its base radius. A hemisphere is built on that base into the cone’s half-space. What fraction of the cone lateral surface lies outside it?
problems.idea: Use the identity or geometric relation below, including the domain restrictions.
formulas: Let base radius r,apex height2r. A point a fraction t along a generator from apex has radial coordinate rt,height2r(1−t).
steps: The hemisphere intersection satisfies t²+4(1−t)²=1,whose roots are t=3/5 and1.
The apex-side cone portion outside the hemisphere is similar with generator ratio3/5.

problems.title: Two cones in a cylinder
problems.question: A cylinder has radius3,height8. Two right circular cones share a radius3 base at its mid-height and lie inside the cylinder. Find the least cylinder-lateral-area divided by total cone-lateral-area.
problems.idea: Use the identity or geometric relation below, including the domain restrictions.
formulas: Each cone height is at most4,so each slant height is at most√(3²+4²)=5.
steps: Their lateral-area sum is at most2·π·3·5=30π,attained with apices at the two end-base centers.

problems.title: Rotate an equilateral triangle about a side
problems.question: An equilateral triangle rotates about a line containing one side. Find surface area of the resulting solid divided by the triangle area.
problems.idea: Use the identity or geometric relation below, including the domain restrictions.
formulas: For side a,the solid is two cones joined at a base of radius√3a/2,each slant length a.

problems.title: Cylinder around a right triangular prism
problems.question: A right triangular prism with base sides6,8,10 has volume48 and is inscribed in a cylinder. Find cylinder total surface area.
problems.idea: Use the identity or geometric relation below, including the domain restrictions.
formulas: Base triangle area=24,so prism and cylinder height=48/24=2. Its circumradius is10/2=5.

problems.title: Height from a frustum’s total surface
problems.question: A cone frustum has radii6,14 and total area572π. Find its height.
problems.idea: Use the identity or geometric relation below, including the domain restrictions.
formulas: Total area=π(6²+14²)+π(6+14)l.

problems.title: A cube in a hemisphere
problems.question: A cube has four vertices on a hemisphere’s flat base and four on its curved surface. The hemisphere radius is√6. Find cube volume.
problems.idea: Use the identity or geometric relation below, including the domain restrictions.
formulas: If cube edge is a,the upper vertex distance squared from the sphere center is a²+(a√2/2)²=3a²/2.

problems.title: Split a cone frustum’s lateral area
problems.question: A frustum has base radii1:2. A parallel plane splits its height1:2,with the larger part next to the larger base. Find its lateral-area split.
problems.idea: Use the identity or geometric relation below, including the domain restrictions.
formulas: The intermediate radius is r+(2r−r)/3=4r/3. Similar cone lateral areas are proportional to squared radii.
steps: The two area parts are proportional to(4r/3)²−r² and(2r)²−(4r/3)².

problems.title: Insphere of a regular triangular pyramid
problems.question: A regular triangular pyramid has base side6√3 and apothem5. Find its insphere radius.
problems.idea: Use the identity or geometric relation below, including the domain restrictions.
formulas: Base apothem=3,pyramid height=√(25−9)=4; r=3V/S_total.
